nativeComparisons.compares: 300 byte-exact outputs over 75 synthesized dumps (depths 8/13/14/20/21/28 x periods 0/22675/1/0x1FFFFF x 0/1/7 packets with 7-bit payloads, plus 3 dumps with 8-bit payloads), each as copy framecrc, -cpuflags 0 s16le decode, -bitexact WAV and copy to u32le; 90 byte-exact timing outputs (-t, -frames:a, declared -f sds, copy and filtered decode to framecrc/WAV). proposedContracts.name: unpacks byte2, byte3 and byte4 packets into left-justified 32-bit words as native does
proposedContracts.scope: byte2/3/4_read against independent formulas, including byte2's addition for 8-bit bytes. No native run.

proposedContracts.name: maps bit depths to widths and sample periods to integer rates
proposedContracts.scope: Depth-to-width mapping for 8..28 and refusals; integer 1e9/period with 16000 for period 0; 7-bit period decode.

proposedContracts.name: parses the header and checks every packet with bounded reads before returning samples
proposedContracts.scope: 2-byte reads, no payload reads on open, re-chunked packets with seeks and budgets, packetSpan 60/40/30. Synthetic inputs.

proposedContracts.name: refuses bad depths, framing and truncation up front
proposedContracts.scope: Truncated header and packet, trailing bytes, bad F0 7E, missing F7, depth 7/29, budgets and short reads. Synthetic inputs.

proposedContracts.name: matches native SDS copy framecrc, s16le decode and WAV for six bit depths four periods and zero one or seven packets
proposedContracts.scope: 75 synthesized dumps x 4 outputs (copy framecrc, s16le, WAV, u32le) byte-exact against the Linux oracle.

proposedContracts.name: matches native SDS packet timing for -t, -frames:a, declared -f sds and filtered decode
proposedContracts.scope: -t, -frames:a and declared -f sds on three widths and two rates, copy and filtered decode, framecrc and WAV. No input -ss (refused).

proposedContracts.name: refuses malformed SDS before any output and records native exit statuses
proposedContracts.scope: 10 malformed inputs with native exit statuses asserted; Edge refuses all before output. Also covers the input -ss refusal and the absence of a muxer.

notes: Setup durations: submodule init 37 s; npm ci 8 s; npm run reference:build 143 s; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+unit suite 114 s.
Native accepts malformed packets mid-stream with exit 0; Edge refuses them up front as the spec directs, so exit statuses intentionally differ for those cases (recorded in the test).
Input -ss is refused because native's generic-index seek yields negative-shifted timestamps and a demux error; mirroring it would need a seek model beyond the registry contract.
The memory plan's maxBufferBytes must not exceed the filesystem read/write budget (as in the w64 tests); the differential tests align them.
No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
